text:
Equipment:
 Potential Transformer
 220kv
 WP245N3/S, UCL 220, CVE 245
Introduction
This document lists the equipment
inspection I1, which must be performed every two
months as indicated by M2 in the title block.
The first 
draft initiated by Mr. Helmut Canadian SISP, S/S specialist, first approval at 
02 Sep.1996, first review date 03 March 2002, 
and 2nd review date 15 Jan. 2006.
The document was updated by 
Ataka PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, 
 ... etc.
Potential transformer must be isolated and proper grounding is required
There is danger of falling off the top of the PT stack when cleaning
 insulators or checking connections
Wear your safety belt
Tools and Equipment
Safety shoes, safety helmet, and safety belt.
Work to be Carried Out
Check primary bus connection for tightness
Check for any signs of oil leaks
Check porcelains for chips, cracks, cementing, and
 fastenings.
Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces.
Check for signs of overheating or flashovers.
